propositions: A blocking finding longer than 240 characters is clipped mid-text with no ellipsis or marker, so the author cannot tell text was removed.
When more than 10 blocking findings exist, the extra findings are dropped with no 'N more' overflow note, understating what must be fixed.
The truncation is inconsistent with the module's own explicit truncation marker convention used in voter.py.
The comment must add an explicit clip marker and an omitted-count note while keeping the cap and preserving full machine-readable findings.
Reproduced via public code_review_decision with 11 over-cap findings: header claimed 11 but only 10 clipped bullets rendered with no disclosure.
